findings.description: The port changes `no_proxy` matching so that an entry now matches only on a domain boundary (exact host or `.`-prefixed suffix). This drops the previous plain-suffix matching, so entries like `example.com` no longer match `myexample.com`. Behavior also changes for entries that already contained a leading dot.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `no_proxy=ample.com` with URL `http://example.com`. The old code matched because of `endswith`, but the new code does not. Impact: requests that were previously bypassing the proxy now go through it. This is the intended bpo-39057 behavior, but it is a behavior change.
